test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Identify the most suitable inference from the given passage.

options.text: Colds are minor infections of the nose and throat caused by viruses. Rhinovirus is the most common cause of common cold.
Medical Science has not yet resolved the problem of the common cold. Therefore, we have to suffer colds for some more time.
When your immune system is exposed to a new germ for the first time, it responds by trying to fight it off.
The viruses causing cold attack only on the surface and become immune to it.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The passage **explains** the challenges medical science faces in solving the problem of the common cold, despite advances in other areas such as transplant surgery and eradicating diseases like** Typhus and the Plague.**
 
• It** highlights** the difficulties posed by the variety of viruses causing colds and the technical challenges in studying these viruses.
 
• The conclusion that we will have to suffer colds for some **time** yet is made clear at the end of the passage.
 
• **In summary, option 2 best represents the main inference from the passage, emphasizing the ongoing struggle of medical science to solve the problem of the common cold and the implication that we will continue to suffer from colds for the foreseeable future.** Options 1, 3, and 4 either provide factual information or contain inaccuracies that do not capture the core inference of the passage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Colds are minor infections of the nose and throat caused by viruses. Rhinovirus is the most common cause of common cold:** While this statement is true and mentioned in the passage, it is more of a factual summary rather than an inference drawn from the passage.
 
• **When your immune system is exposed to a new germ for the first time, it responds by trying to fight it off:** This is a general statement about the immune response and is not the main inference to be drawn from the passage.
 
• **The viruses causing cold attack only on the surface and become immune to it:** This statement is incorrect as it misrepresents the function and behavior of cold viruses. The passage does not discuss viruses becoming immune to anything.
 
• In **summary**, **option 2** best represents the main inference from the passage, emphasizing the ongoing struggle of medical science to solve the problem of the common cold and the implication that we will continue to suffer from colds for the foreseeable future. **Options 1, 3, and 4** either provide factual information or contain inaccuracies that do not capture the core inference of the passage.
